The letter {{AurB|d}} was the fourth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|writing system]]. It was pronounced "dorn" and corresponded to the letter /D/ in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
